note: Bulk crates: pay upfront for N lever pulls sight-unseen, all added straight to inventory. Prices are calibrated by simulation so the crate's total ingredient value beats its price roughly targetWinRate of the time - a real gamble, not a guaranteed discount. Bigger crates cost more per pull but are far safer bets (their outcomes cluster tightly around the true average, per the law of large numbers), so the 50-crate is the real gamble and the 1000-crate is close to a sure thing.
